scope: Data-level reconstruction of the 4x4 InnerType prefix-0 masks joined to every LandMaking preset. Rotation handedness is ranked by cross-cell mask continuity; this does not execute mesh/PBC loading or prove world-space dimensions.

inner_type_layout.field_name_interpretation: InnerType0 followed by two index digits; matrix uses the middle digit as row and last digit as column.
inner_type_layout.water_code_rule: River enum label at InnerType000 or byte value 1 in other prefix-0 cells; used rows with such values are exclusively ModelType River/Fall.
limits: The 4x4 sample coordinates are not proven to be four world-space collision cells.
The source-table variation limit is catalogued but does not reveal PBC geometry for each selected variation.
The direction of native rotation is not read directly; candidate handedness is inferred from mask continuity across the 96 presets.

rotation_consistency.test: For adjacent 112x96 preset cells, compare their opposing edges across four prefix-0 InnerType samples, then count 4-way connected components on the assembled 448x384 sample raster.
rotation_consistency.native_rotation_field_transfer: 0x558f40 copies each source rotation byte into the destination cell; see island_terrain_loader_native.json.
rotation_consistency.inference_limit: A lower mismatch/component score is consistency evidence, not a native proof of rotation handedness or rendered water connectivity. Remaining edge mismatches may involve Falls, height transitions, or other terrain rules.
